title: AquaSteel — Cold for 24, Ready for Anything

beats.text: Okay, I need to show you the one thing that finally fixed my hydration — this is the AquaSteel, and it keeps my water ice-cold for a full 24 hours.
beats.background_query: bright modern kitchen interior morning light
beats.visual: Spokesperson holds the AquaSteel up to camera, condensation-free, in a sunlit kitchen

beats.text: I used to grab a cheap plastic bottle before a hike, and two hours in it was warm, leaking all over my bag, and honestly kind of gross.
beats.background_query: sunny outdoor hiking trail with trees
beats.visual: Spokesperson on a trail, frustrated, shaking a warm leaky plastic bottle

beats.text: The AquaSteel is double-wall vacuum insulated — cold for 24 hours, hot for 12 — with a twist-and-lock leak-proof lid, and this 750ml size gets me through the whole day on one fill.
beats.visual: Close demo at a tidy desk — twist the lid shut, flip it upside down, no leaks

beats.text: I've been using mine every single day for months — gym, work, weekend trails — and it still looks brand new thanks to that powder-coated grip. I'm genuinely obsessed.
beats.visual: Spokesperson relaxed in a cafe, sipping from the AquaSteel, easy authentic smile

beats.text: For thirty-four bucks in six bold colors, this is a no-brainer — tap the link and grab yours before your favorite sells out.
beats.visual: Spokesperson at the gym points to camera, then to the AquaSteel — confident CTA
